question: The foundation classifier sometimes contributes useful probabilities. Can its internal row representations, used as a frozen downstream encoder like a sentence encoder, carry additional information for a task-specific supervised head?
encoder: Pinned offline TabICLv2 2.0.3 and the previously verified classifier checkpoint. Draw the first of five stratified exact-feature group folds from 4061 fitting rows with seed 38317 as a fixed labeled reference bank. Fit the frozen published estimator with one input view on that bank alone. Observe the row interaction output for the other four folds and for the development queries, always in cached query-only inference. No head-training or evaluation label is supplied to the encoder; require the same sample representation within small numerical tolerance when its batch companions or order change.
heads: Fit one raw one-hot logistic head and one logistic head on the same raw features plus standardized row embeddings, with C=.1. Fit one native categorical tree and one with the same categories plus at most 32 principal row-embedding coordinates at identical settings, depth 6, 600 trees. Fit an additional signed logistic offset using normalized embeddings to the pre-existing held-out probabilities of the stronger pair, with penalty 24 and log-odds correction clipped to 1.25. All scalers, projection and supervised heads see only the four fitting folds. The same fixed reference-bank classifier probabilities are a diagnostic. Compare direct and raw controls independently of candidate nomination.
election: The enhanced linear, enhanced tree and offset predictions may be retained or blended with the stronger pair using the existing 808-row nomination, then validated on the 817/807 panels. The two raw heads and reference-bank probability are descriptive comparators. Positive results from these reused panels can warrant a larger training-only test, never a direct course validation claim. No paid model, official test or H2.
